addr: Eastern Block, Jayanagar Shopping Complex, 26, 4th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011, India

rev.t:
Best for: clothes, footwear, accessories, household items and local shopping.
Big advantage: bargaining and variety.
Downside: can be crowded and somewhat old-fashioned. …

My visit for a spring potato was completely disappointing. The potato wasn't fried correctly, resulting in an unappetizing texture. The person serving was unresponsive to requests, prioritizing customers who just walked up and asked over …
I had a good shopping experience here, only women's wear are available here and if you are lucky you can buy good quality clothes for affordable prices
